title: Block or unblock a position
purpose: Take one position in a box out of use, or return it, with a recorded reason.
summary: Take one position in a box out of use, or return it, with a recorded reason. Admin and manager only.

tasks.title: Block the position
steps: Give the [[Reason for the change]] and select [[Block position]].

tasks.title: Return it to use
steps: Give the reason and select [[Unblock position]].

good_to_know: A blocked position is never offered as free.
An occupied position cannot be blocked. Move the item out first.
The block reason shows on hover over the Blocked tag.

sections.title: Who and when
paragraphs: Admin and manager roles. Reached from a position label on the box page while the box is active. A blocked position is never offered as free. An occupied position cannot be blocked: move the item out first. Blocking a position in a retired box is refused. The page title says Block position or Unblock position by the current state; unblocking shows why it was blocked.

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Required, up to 2000 characters. Kept in the history. When blocking, it is also stored as the block reason and shown on hover over the Blocked tag.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: If the position changed since you opened the page the save is refused with a message to reload. Blocking and unblocking are audited with the reason.

items.label: Block position / Unblock position
items.description: Applies the change and returns to the box.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the box without saving.
